Record Class Seed

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.Seed
Record Components:
value - the 64 bits of the seed
public record Seed(long value) extends Record
A seed from which other seeds are derived by name or by number, so that each part of a program has a random sequence of its own that only depends on the seed and on what the part is, not on what was generated before it. 
var world = Seed.of("my world");
var terrain = world.derive("terrain");
var chunk = terrain.derive(x).derive(y).generator();   // the same chunk, whenever it's generated
var loot = world.derive("loot").derive(chestId).generator();

Deriving is deterministic and its result is part of this class's contract: a seed derives the same seeds in every version and on every JVM. Seeds derived with different keys, or with the same keys in another order, are unrelated.

Since:
0.2.0
